address: Rue du Colonel Tachet des Combes 19, Yvoir, 5530, Belgium
bio: Make no mistake, you are light years from your run-of-the-mill Italian restaurant in this modern eatery. The Mona Lisa is helmed by a couple of Sicilian parentage, who are proud of their first-rate produce and of lovingly crafting old-fashioned Italian recipes. The gutsy flavours of the ravioli explode in the mouth, underscored by a creamy burrata, while the signature chocolate dessert is deliciously balanced. We highly recommend the set menu with options....
